content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

When conventional payment platforms restrict access or charge exorbitant fees, creators lose out on profitability. For example, Gumroad takes 10% on every sale, which can significantly impact your earnings. In contrast, with NOWPayments charging only 0.5%, you retain more revenue, allowing you to invest back into your business. This infrastructure provides you with complete ownership and control over your digital sales process, eliminating reliance on platforms that don’t serve your needs.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To successfully launch your digital product sales, start by selecting the right tools. You will need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic service such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a storage option like Supabase or Google Sheets. Additionally, set up file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless access to your products. Finally, ensure you have your NOWPayments account ready for crypto transactions. This foundational setup is critical for an efficient deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by integrating NOWPayments with your chosen hosting solution. Create a product listing for each digital product you plan to sell, making sure to include relevant details. Configure your delivery mechanism so that files automatically send upon successful payment confirmation. Utilize Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage this automation smoothly. This step ensures that your customers receive their purchases instantly, enhancing their buying experience and reducing your workload.
Retain more revenue by avoiding high platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once everything is set up, it’s time to launch. Promote your digital products through social media or your existing channels. Direct potential customers to your storefront, ensuring they understand the benefits of paying with crypto. Monitor your first transaction closely, confirming that the payment is processed correctly and that delivery occurs as planned. This initial transaction is crucial for testing the functionality of your infrastructure, allowing you to make any necessary adjustments before scaling.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully selling your initial products, consider expanding your offerings. You can add more products to your existing stack, increase your marketing efforts, and explore partnerships for greater reach. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides additional blueprints and templates that can help you enhance your digital shop's capabilities. Scaling is about optimizing your current infrastructure and increasing your product range while maintaining the efficiency that you’ve established.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept a variety of cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. By leveraging an infrastructure stack that includes free hosting and automated delivery tools, you can create a seamless purchasing experience for your customers.
Own your infrastructure, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This comprehensive package equips you with all the necessary tools and templates to establish a fully operational digital storefront using crypto payments.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Select a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets. Configure file delivery with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Create a NOWPayments account for crypto transactions. Integrate payment processing and automate product delivery. Launch your digital store and monitor the first transactions to ensure smooth operations.

You can sell ebooks by using crypto payment processors like NOWPayments, which allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies. Set up your hosting and delivery infrastructure to automate the process, ensuring customers receive their purchases immediately after payment.

Utilize a sovereign commerce stack that includes tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This approach minimizes fees and provides complete ownership of your sales process, maximizing your profits.

Yes, with the right infrastructure, you can sell templates and fonts directly. Use a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, automated delivery through Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions to bypass traditional platforms.

Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to trigger automatic file delivery upon payment confirmation. This ensures that your customers receive their digital products instantly, improving their buying experience.
